title: Advertisement
description: Definition of Advertisement under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: any audio or visual publicity, representation, endorsement or pronouncement made by means of light, sound, smoke, gas, print, electronic media, internet or website and includes any notice, circular, label, wrapper, invoice or such other documents
content.plain_language: a public announcement or promotion using various media like audio, video, print, internet, etc.
examples: A company running a TV commercial to promote its new product
A social media post endorsing a brand
non_examples: A private conversation between friends about a product
A personal social media post not endorsing any brand

user_queries: What is an advertisement under the Consumer Protection Act
How is advertisement defined in the CPA 2019
